senses.gloss: (preced.) = b. h. רבה [to stretch the bow string, cmp. Lat. intendo arcum,] to shoot.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 21:20">Targ. O. Gen. XXI, 20</cite> <he>והוה רָבֵי קַשְׁתָּא</he> and he became an archer; [ed. Berl. <he>רָבְיָא קַשָּׁתָא</he> an archer-boy].

senses.gloss: <cite ref="T00082">same</cite>. Targ. Y. ib. <he>והוה יליף רַבֵּי קַשְׁוָותָא</he> and he learned how to shoot with bows.
